admission.heading: Eligibility Criteria
rows: Must have passed 10+2 or equivalent with physics, chemistry, biology/biotechnology, and English as core subjects from a recognized board.
General Category: Minimum 50% aggregate in PCB - SC/ST/OBC: Minimum 40% aggregate - PwD (UR): Minimum 45% aggregate
Must be at least 17 years old as of 31st December 2025. No upper age limit as per the latest NEET rules.
Must be an Indian citizen or an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI).
For the state quota (85%), candidates must be a Goa domicile (as per DTE Goa norms).
Must qualify for NEET-UG 2025 conducted by NTA. Admission is strictly based on NEET rank and score.
The candidate must be medically fit as per prescribed standards.

admission.heading: Selection Criteria
rows: The candidate must appear for NEET-UG 2025 and secure the qualifying percentile.
Based on NEET scores, separate merit lists are prepared for 15% All India Quota (AIQ) and 85% Goa State Quota
AIQ seats: Filled via MCC (Medical Counseling Committee) - State Quota seats: Filled through DTE Goa counseling based on Goa domicile and merit.
Seats are allotted as per NEET rank, category reservation, and college preference.
Shortlisted candidates must report to the GMC for document verification, fee payment, and a medical fitness check to confirm admission.

admission.heading: MMC Muzaffarnagar Admission 2026 Highlights
rows: Key Takeaways from the Video: The video discusses NEET 2025 counseling for Muzaffarnagar Medical College (MMC) and raises concerns about hidden fees charged by the college. It cautions students about additional unauthorized fees beyond the normal defined fee structure and has uncovered widespread practice in some of the private medical colleges in Uttar Pradesh. Reported types of issues include extortion, fees being charged like fines, and being asked to pay undisclosed amounts to pass reports, exams, or reserve seats. A number of commenters on the foray would agree, and similar experiences can be found on Reddit that suggest this is common following an application for admission, and that hidden fees can grossly inflate the financial burden of students (though not all private colleges practice this behavior). Most of these hidden fees appear to increase the total financial burden by around INR 80 lakh, if not INR 1 crore, if one factors in the tuition fee, hostel fee, fees charged unofficially, etc. This video is a reminder to check the actual fee details during counseling whenever possible, especially for private colleges, such as MMC, so that there are no surprises in terms of finances.

admission.heading: VGSOM MBA Admission 2026
rows: Important Points Students Should Know CAT Sectional Weightage: VGSOM gives extra importance to your scores in VARC, DILR, and QA. So even if your overall percentile is good, weak performance in one section can affect shortlisting. Work Experience: Not compulsory, but it helps. Longer and better-quality work experience gives extra points in the Application Rating. Reserved Categories: Cutoffs and shortlisting are lower for SC/ST/PwD/EWS/OBC candidates. No GD: There is no Group Discussion only Personal Interview. Final Result: Usually declared in the first week of May 2026.

admission.heading: VGSOM CAT Cutoff 2026
rows: Prashant Kumar Singh from MBA, Human Resource Management (2022) has to say about Admission at VGSOM,Regarding the Admission: he says, “ELIGIBILITY Bachelor's degree in Engineering/ Technology or Master's degree in science, arts, commerce, etc. Reservation Benefits are here like tuition fees waived for ST/SC/PED. Criteria of Admission change every year, No uniform weightage for 10th, 12th, and graduation marks, graduation marks have very high weightage and PI is the game changer which is again a win or lose game..” To read more about his review, click here

admission.heading: VGSOM Ph.D Admission 2026
rows: Candidates who wish to apply should complete their registration on the official IIT Kharagpur website for entry into the Ph.D. program at VGSOM.

Candidates must have a valid CAT / GATE / GRE / GMAT / UGC-NET / JRF score. Certain candidates (like those with degrees from IITs or IIMs with high CGPA (above ~8) may be exempted from entrance tests, as per IIT Kharagpur’s Ph.D. regulations.
Based on the submitted academic credentials and test scores, candidates will be shortlisted for the interview round by the respective academic units.

The final admission decisions are determined by the candidate's overall performance in academics, entrance examinations, interviews, and the availability of mentors and funding. Those who are chosen will receive an official offer letter from IIT Kharagpur.

admission.heading: VGSOM PGDBA Admission 2026
rows: Eligible candidates must apply online through the official PGDBA admission portal: (pgdba.iitkgp.ac.in) The form is common for all three institutes (IIT Kharagpur, IIM Calcutta, and ISI Kolkata).

Candidates who are shortlisted will take a written examination organized collaboratively by the three partner institutes. This assessment evaluates skills in mathematics, logical reasoning, and data interpretation..

Candidates who perform well on the written test are invited for a personal interview, which usually takes place at one or more of the three campuses. The evaluation also takes into academic history and professional experience.
The final merit list is prepared based on written test score, interview performance, academic background, and work experience (if any). Admission offers are made by the PGDBA office.

admission.heading: Arvind Gavali College of Engineering B.Tech and Polytechnic Admission 2024
rows: The Candidate should be an Indian National ; Passed 10th Std./ SSC examination or its equivalent, with at least 35% aggregate marks.

Maharashtra State Candidature Candidate: The Candidate should be an Indian National; Passed 10+2 examination with Physics/ Mathematics /Chemistry / Computer Science /Electronics /Information Technology/ Biology / Informatics Practices/ Biotechnology /Technical Vocational subject/ Agriculture/ Engineering Graphics / Business Studies/Entrepreneurship (Any of the three). OR 10th + (2 years ITI) shall be eligible for admission to Second Year Diploma Course(s) in ANY branch of Engineering and Technology. (The Affiliating Body will offer suitable bridge courses such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering drawing, etc., for the students coming from diverse backgrounds to achieve desired learning outcomes of the programme) Note: Other than Maharashtra State Candidates shall be eligible for Institution quota only. NRI / OCI / PIO, Children of Indian workers in the Gulf countries, Foreign National: Passed HSC Science with subjects English, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Any other criterion declared from time to time by the appropriate authority as defined under the Rules.

Maharashtra State Candidature Candidate: The candidate should be an Indian National; Passed HSC or its equivalent examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of the Chemistry or Biotechnology or Biology or Technical Vocational subjects, or Computer Science or Information Technology or Informatics Practices or Agriculture or Engineering Graphics or Business Studies or Electronics or Entrepreneurship and obtained at least 45 % marks (at least 40 % marks, in case of Backward class categories, Economically Weaker Section and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) in the above subjects taken together; and The Candidate should have appeared in all the subjects in MHT-CET 2024 and should obtain non zero score in MHT- CET 2024 conducted by the Competent Authority Or Passed minimum 3 years Diploma in Engineering and Technology and obtained at least 45 % marks (at least 40 % marks, in case of Backward class categories Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) Or Passed three years D. Voc. Stream in the same or allied sector. All India Candidature Candidates, Jammu and Kashmir Migrant Candidature Candidates: The Candidate should be an Indian National; Passed HSC or its equivalent examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of the Chemistry or Biotechnology or Biology or Technical Vocational subject or Computer Science or Information Technology or Informatics Practices or Agriculture or Engineering Graphics or Business Studies or Electronics or Entrepreneurship and obtained at least 45% marks (at least 40% marks, in case of Backward class categories, Economically Weaker Section and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) in the above subjects taken together and should obtain non zero positive score in JEE Main (B.E/B.Tech) or the candidate should have appeared in all the Subjects in MHT-CET 2024 and should obtain non zero score in MHT-CET 2024. However, preference shall be given to the candidate obtaining non zero positive score in JEE Main (B.E/B.Tech) over the candidates who obtained non zero scores in MHT-CET 2024. Or Passed minimum 3 years Diploma in Engineering and Technology and obtained at least 45% marks (at least 40% marks, in case of Backward class categories, economically Weaker Section and Persons with Disability candidates belonging to Maharashtra State only) Or Passed three years D. Voc. Stream in the same or allied sector. NRI/OCI/PIO, Children of Indian workers in Gulf Countries (CIWGC), Foreign National (FN) Candidates: The candidate should have passed the HSC or its equivalent examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of the Chemistry or Biotechnology or Biology or Technical Vocational Subject or Computer Science or Information Technology or Informatics Practices or Agriculture or Engineering Graphics or Business Studies or Electronics or Entrepreneurship subjects, and obtained at least 45% marks in the above subjects taken together; Any other criterion declared From time to time by the appropriate authority as defined under the Act.

For Maharashtra State Candidature Candidate and All India Candidature Candidate – The Candidate should be an Indian National; Passed minimum three years or two years (Lateral Entry) Diploma Course in Engineering and Technology with at least 45% marks (40% marks in case of Candidates of Backward Class categories, Economically Weaker Section and Persons with Disability category belonging to Maharashtra State) in any branch of Engineering and Technology from an All India Council for Technical Education or Central or State Government approved Institution or its equivalent; OR Passed B.Sc. Degree from a University Grants Commission (UGC) or Association of Indian Universities recognized University with at least 45% marks (40% in case of candidates of Backward Class categories, Economically Weaker Section and Persons with Disability category belonging to Maharashtra State) and passed HSC or its equivalent examination with Mathematics as a subject; OR Passed D.Voc. Stream in the same or allied sector ( refer Schedule III); Any other criterion declared from time to time by the appropriate authority as defined under the Act.

admission.heading: Arvind Gavali College of Engineering M.Tech Admission 2024
rows: For Maharashtra Candidature Candidate and All India Candidature Candidate: The Candidate should be an Indian National; Passed Bachelor Degree in the relevant field of Engineering and Technology or Pharmacy from All India Council for Technical Education or Central or State Government approved institutions or equivalent, with at least 50% marks (at least 45% marks in case of candidates of Backward Class categories, Economically weaker section and Persons with Disability category belonging to Maharashtra State); Passed Bachelor Degree in the relevant course of Engineering and Technology or Pharmacy as specified in the eligibility criteria for admission to a Post Graduate Degree course of the concerned University for which admission is being sought; Obtained Qualified score in Graduates Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology and valid for the current academic year; or Obtained non-Qualified marks in Graduates Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology for the current academic year; Obtained Qualified score in Graduates Pharmacy Aptitude Test (GPAT) conducted by National Testing Agency and valid for the current academic year; or Obtained non-Qualified marks in Graduates Pharmacy Aptitude Test (GPAT) conducted by National Testing Agency for the current academic year; or For sponsored candidates, minimum of two years of full time work experience in a registered firm/ company/ industry/ educational and/ or research institute/ any Government Department or Government Autonomous Organization in the relevant field in which admission is being sought; GATE or GPAT Qualified Candidates shall have preference over the not qualified Candidates. NRI/OCI/PIO, Children of Indian workers in Gulf Countries (CIWGC), ForeignNational (FN) Candidates: Passed Bachelor Degree in the relevant field of Engineering and Technology from All IndiaCouncil for Technical Education or Central or State Government approved institutions or equivalent, with at least 50% marks; Passed Bachelor Degree in the relevant course of Engineering and Technology as specified in the eligibility criteria for admission to a Post Graduate Degree course of the concerned University for which admission is beingsought; Any other criterion declared from time to time by the appropriate authority as defined under the Act

admission.heading: BNCET Lucknow B.Tech Admissions 2026
rows: Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects, along with Chemistry/Biotechnology/Computer Science/Biology or a Technical Vocational subject. A minimum of 45% marks (40% for SC/ST category) is required.
Selection is based on a valid JEE Main or UPCET score followed by UPTAC counselling. Admission is offered to eligible candidates based on merit and seat availability in preferred specialisations.

admission.heading: BNCET Lucknow B.Tech Lateral Entry Admissions 2026
rows: Diploma holders in Engineering/Technology with at least 45% marks (40% for SC/ST) or B.Sc. graduates with Mathematics as a subject can apply.
Candidates must qualify UPCET (Lateral Entry) for admission. Counselling is conducted by AKTU.

admission.heading: BNCET Lucknow Polytechnic Admissions 2026
rows: Candidates must have passed Class 10 from a recognised board with minimum qualifying marks.
Selection is based on JEECUP scores. Counselling is conducted at the state level and seat allotment is based on rank and availability.

admission.heading: BNCET Lucknow MBA Admissions 2026
rows: A bachelor’s degree in any discipline with at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST) is required.

Selection is through scores obtained in MAT, CAT, or UPCET, followed by group discussion and/or personal interview rounds as per institutional norms. Final admission is subject to seat allotment via counselling or direct admission based on merit and availability.

admission.heading: BNCET Lucknow M.Tech Admissions 2026
rows: Applicants must possess a B.E./B.Tech degree in the relevant discipline with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved categories).

Admission is primarily through GATE or UPCET, with preference given to GATE-qualified candidates. Non-GATE applicants may be admitted based on institutional test or merit in qualifying degree, followed by counselling.

fees.heading: GCET Scholarship
rows: The University offers Merit Scholarships to reward academic excellence among second, third, fourth, and fifth-year students, based on their CGPA at the end of each academic year. The scholarships are awarded to the top three rankers in each batch and programme, provided they have passed all examinations on their first attempt. The number of scholarships granted depends on the number of students appearing in the semester or year-end examinations: one scholarship for 1-30 students, two scholarships for 31-120 students, and three scholarships for more than 120 students. The scholarship amount is set at 30% of the tuition fee for the following year and is rounded to the next multiple of Rs. 100/-.The scholarship will be adjusted in the subsequent year's fee installment. However, it can be discontinued if the student is found guilty of unfair practices in exams, or if the Head of the Department reports charges such as misconduct, misbehavior, gross indiscipline, ragging, or involvement with drugs or narcotics. In such cases, the scholarship will be discontinued with effect from the date approved by the Vice Chancellor.

rows: Prateeksha Singh (B.Tech CSE, 2024 batch) highlights that placements at KIT Kanpur begin from the 6th semester, with around 60% of students getting placed annually. The highest package reported is around INR 10 LPA, the lowest around INR 2 LPA, and the average package is approximately INR 4 LPA. While placement opportunities are available, the student notes that packages are comparatively modest. She expects placements to improve as the college has recently become autonomous and aligned its curriculum with industry requirements. Read more.

If you’re passionate about commerce, LCIT Bilaspur stands out as a top choice in the city, known for its vibrant atmosphere and supportive faculty—many of whom are young and highly qualified. The B.Com program has a yearly exam pattern (not semester-based), with regular assignments and internal assessments. Placement opportunities in B.Com are mainly available in the final year, typically for entry-level roles, with an average package of around ₹3LPA; companies like TCS, Wipro, and various edtech startups also recruit here. The annual fee is ₹30,000, with no major scholarships known, but the campus offers excellent facilities, including library book lending, active sports and cultural events, a large campus, and lively, safe campus life. admission.heading: MGM Nanded Admission Process
rows: Register online on cetcell.mahacet.org during the application window. Fill in personal, academic details, upload documents, and pay the registration fee.
Appear for MHT-CET (or JEE Main if you wish to compete under All India Quota).
Download your MHT-CET scorecard when results are declared.
Register for Centralized Admission Process (CAP) — this is mandatory. Upload documents for verification (marksheets, caste/income certificate if applicable, domicile).
Verify uploaded documents through Facilitation Centers (FCs) — online or in-person.
DTE publishes a Provisional Merit List — check your rank, report discrepancies if any.
DTE publishes the Final Merit List for Maharashtra State, All India, TFWS, EWS, and Minority quotas.
Fill Option Form online for your college & branch preferences (multiple rounds allowed).
Seats are allotted based on your rank, preferences, category, and availability. Provisional Allotment is published for each round.
Accept allotted seat online → Pay seat acceptance fee → Choose Freeze, Float, or Slide option.
Report to the allotted college (like MGMCET/MGMCOE) with originals & pay admission fees.
If not allotted, participate in the next CAP rounds or the Institute Level Spot Round for vacant seats.

admission.heading: IMS Ghaziabad MBA Admission 2026
rows: Important Points Students Should Know Students can book their GD-PI slots here. The GD-PI sessions are conducted in multiple rounds depending upon the number of applications received. After successfully attending the GD-PI session, the results are usually declared within 7 to 10 days from the date of the GD-PI. Once the results are announced, students are required to complete the initial fee payment within 20 days of the result declaration to confirm their admission and secure their seat in the program. Work Experience: Not compulsory, but it helps. Longer and better-quality work experience may give extra points in the interview. Class Commencement: Usually starts in the Last week of July or first week of August 2026.

admission.heading: IMS Ghaziabad MBA Admission 2026
rows: The IMS Ghaziabad interview focuses on your true personality, not just marks. From discussions on Quora User, below is a simple overview of his Interview experience: Know yourself: Be ready to answer ‘Tell me about yourself’ in 1 to 2 minutes (include family, education, goals, hobbies, and why MBA). Why IMS Ghaziabad and why MBA? Explain honestly how the institute fits your career dreams and what you like about its programs (like innovation focus or specializations). Current affairs & business news: Read newspapers daily for GD topics (e.g., elections, startups, economy issues like Byju's or Zomato changes). Your resume: Talk about academics, work experience (if any), projects, strengths/weaknesses, role models, and extracurriculars with real examples. GD tips: Speak clearly, listen to others, add good points without arguing, and summarize at the end. Be polite and team-oriented. PI tips: Stay confident, smile, make eye contact, dress neatly, and be honest, if you don't know something, say so calmly.

Connect with admissions team member to discuss career goals, aspirations, and questions.
Use 'Apply Yourself' portal; fill form, upload docs. Submit CV, 3 essays, personal statement, executive assessment.

- Copies of degree certificates & mark sheets (carry originals to interview) - Updated CV/Resume - 3 Written Essays - Personal Statement - Executive Assessment - 2 Recommendation Letters (from senior executives/supervisors) - Commitment/Sponsorship Letter from employer - ID proof (for interview prep) - Proof of English proficiency (assessed in interview or TOEFL/IELTS if needed)
Personal interview via Zoom with the Admissions Committee (IITB faculty, WashU faculty, CEO). Assesses qualifications, motivation, communication, leadership, and fit.
Submit any remaining recommendation letters and sponsor commitment letters.
If selected: Pay booking amount + first installment immediately.
- Bachelor's degree (UGC-recognized) - 7+ years full-time work experience or 5+ years managerial experience - Excellent English skills - Strong interview performance
GMAT/GRE/CAT, Not required for most, optional to show quantitative skills.
Batch 11 starts January 2026, Fee: INR 45 Lakhs (non-refundable; includes textbooks, materials, lodging/meals for residencies).
